name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit_StDev
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator with StDev (Standard Deviation) filtering. It enters positions when the colored moving average changes direction, confirmed by standard deviation volatility conditions. The strategy combines a digitally-smoothed variable-period moving average with volatility filtering for trend reversal entries.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXvaMA_Digit指标配合标准差(StDev)过滤进行交易。当彩色变周期均线改变方向且标准差波动率条件满足时开仓。策略结合数字平滑变周期移动平均线和波动率过滤来捕捉趋势反转入场点。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于ColorXvaMA_Digit指标的变色均线信号，该指标是一种数字平滑的变周期移动平均线，当均线颜色从一种变为另一种时代表趋势方向发生改变。入场条件为均线颜色切换且标准差(StDev)达到一定阈值，标准差过滤用于确认波动率足够支持趋势反转的有效性。出场条件主要依赖反向均线颜色信号或止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过MM参数控制下单量。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比模式可选，但没有动态仓位调整机制。整体策略属于均值回归类型，在趋势反转点入场，依赖波动率确认信号有效性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator's color-changing moving average signal, which is a digitally-smoothed variable-period moving average that changes color to indicate trend direction shifts. Entry conditions require the moving average color to switch and the standard deviation (StDev) to reach a specified threshold, where the StDev filter confirms sufficient volatility to support a valid trend reversal. Exit conditions primarily rely on the opposite moving average color signal or user-configured stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach controlled by the MM parameter, with an optional risk-percentage mode available. Money management offers a percentage risk mode but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account equity changes. The overall strategy is mean-reversion in nature, entering at trend reversal points and relying on volatility confirmation for signal validity.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop adjustment step in points

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 手数管理模式：0=固定手数，1=风险百分比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio parameter, controls position sizing

pros: 结合标准差过滤能有效过滤低波动率假信号，提高入场质量
数字平滑变周期均线对市场噪声有较好的过滤能力，信号更稳定
提供多种仓位管理模式（固定手数和风险百分比），灵活度较高
pros_en: Standard deviation filtering effectively eliminates low-volatility false signals, improving entry quality
The digitally-smoothed variable-period moving average has good noise filtering capability, producing more stable signals
Multiple position sizing modes (fixed lots and risk percentage) provide good flexibility
cons: 止损和止盈默认值为0，未设置时风险敞口极大
缺少新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线内重复开仓
均值回归策略在强趋势市场中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤保护
cons_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, creating enormous risk exposure when not configured
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same bar
Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets without trend filter protection
improvements: 增加强趋势过滤机制，如大周期均线方向判断，避免在单边行情中逆势交易
设置止损止盈默认非零值，并增加新K线检查防止重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a strong trend filter mechanism such as a larger timeframe moving average direction check to avoid counter-trend trading in unilateral markets
Set non-zero default values for stop-loss and take-profit, and add new bar checking to prevent duplicate position openings

risk_points: 止损止盈默认为0，未手动设置时无任何风险保护
缺少新K线检查可能导致同根K线内多次开仓造成过度暴露
risk_points_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, providing no risk protection when not manually configured
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple position openings within the same bar leading to overexposure
